Important IRS Tax Form 5498-SA
Dear Daniel:
The enclosed IRS tax form 5498-SA shows your 2024 contributions to your HSA. Please use this information to fill out IRS
tax form 8889, which is what you'll need to submit your taxes. To find a copy of IRS tax form 8889, visit irs.gov.
Here's what you need to know:
Box 2 shows your total contributions made for 2024 including those made in 2024 for 2023, if applicable.
You have until the tax fling deadline of this year to submit contributions for 2024. If you make any contributions in
2025 before the tax deadline for 2024 you will receive an updated 5498-SA in May.
To get your total contributions for 2024 add Box 2 plus Box 3. Please note if you made any contributions in 2024
for 2023 you need to review your updated 5498 for 2023 and subtract that from Box 3.
The Fair Market Value consists of your HSA cash balance and any investment balance as of 12/31/2024.
If you had a reportable distribution for 2024, you'll also get tax form 1099-SA. If you did not use (no distributions)
your HSA in 2024 you will not get a 1099-SA.
Ready to say goodbye to printed forms? Sign in to your account and navigate to "Account Management." From there,
scrol to "Communication Preferences" and select "Edit." Select the "Online"option to update your tax form delivery
preference.
Questions? Please sign in at optumbank.com to access your HSA or call 1-866-234-8913.
